nuggets.text: The Aggies' mascot, Gunrock, is a mustang, so Saturday's game has mustangs on both sidelines.
Treynor Cleeland's father, Cameron, spent eight years in the NFL as a tight end with the Saints, Patriots and Rams.
Treynor Cleeland threw five touchdown passes in last week's 49-17 win at San Diego.
The Aggies rallied from a 21-0 hole to beat Portland State 31-24 in their season opener.
The Aggies open 2026 with three straight road games, and Saturday in Dallas is the third.
Matteo Perez's 79-yard touchdown run at San Diego is tied for the 13th-longest run in UC Davis history.
Tim Plough played quarterback at UC Davis from 2003 to 2007 and now coaches his alma mater.
After every Aggies win, the Tavernetti Bell is rung once for each point UC Davis scored.
In 2005, the Aggies became the first non-FBS team to beat Stanford, rallying from 17-0 down to win 20-17.
In 1971, the Aggies scored 16 points in the final 44 seconds to beat Cal State Hayward 30-29.
